description: This file is a shell script for testing various scenarios related to object corruption and integrity in Git repositories, including setup procedures, testing corrupted objects, missing objects, misnamed objects, and behaviors of clone and fetch operations under corruption conditions.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object reference into a file path within the .git/objects directory.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Modifies a specific byte in a Git object file to simulate corruption.
